RELATED_NEW.description: Condition first supported after the loss with evidence reasonably connecting its onset to the loss.

AGGRAVATION.description: Established pre-loss condition with evidence of a material post-loss change reasonably attributable to the loss.

PREEXISTING.description: Condition established before the loss without evidence supporting a material post-loss change attributable to the loss.

DEGENERATIVE.description: Condition primarily characterized by chronic degenerative findings rather than an acute traumatic change.

UNRELATED.description: Condition better explained by a separate event or cause.
